new_value: Fixed: waste-alarm block in scripts/fleet-guards.sh now fails loud on helper failure — empty fleet_burn.py output (helper missing at $REPO/scripts/fleet_burn.py or interpreter crash) and unparseable/non-JSON output each echo a dated WARN line naming the failure; legitimate evaluated:false (baseline-establish, mid-window, rolls) stays silent per lh2z design. Verified end-to-end with 4-case stub smoke (missing helper -> WARN no-output; garbage -> WARN not-JSON; real helper first run -> silent legit skip; evaluated:true -> normal alarm path) plus bash -n and the 12-test fleet_burn suite (12/12 pass). 3x codereview delegated to kimi-k3 per protocol (correctness/security/edge): 4 new findings filed as beads (7djg P2 invalid-observation silent gap, ukqv P3 WARN lacks bd-dedup, jju8 P3 stderr discarded, n3y7 P3 CYCLE_MIN hot loop) + dedup comments on existing lbui (tmp state-dir ownership) and rmza (STATE-dir OSError).
